<h1 align="center">Acme Tool</h1>

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/acme.svg)](https://npmjs.com/package/acme)
[![CI](https://github.com/acme/tool/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/acme/tool/actions)

A tiny command line tool that renames your files so they sort the way you think they should.

![demo](docs/demo.gif)

## Install

```bash
$ npm install -g acme-tool
```

## Features

- **Fast** — handles 100k files in under a second
- **Safe** - every rename can be undone with `acme undo`
- Works on Windows, macOS and Linux

## Usage

Run `acme .` in a folder. See [the docs](docs/usage.md) for more.
